messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx and timeouts observed for private-vpc-inference-gateway (prod, eu-west-1). 502/504 spike from 09:12Z. Paging alex (oncall). Link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/INC-7742

alex (oncall): I'm on it. seeing 502 rate ~3.1% for gateway-route-prod vs baseline 0.05%. Affected customers: ACMECorp (private deployment), internal tests failing. Starting triage.

alex (oncall): First look: gateway logs show upstream TCP resets and TLS handshakes timing out. Example:
```
[09:15:42] gateway: upstream_connect_timeout after 10s -> 504
[09:15:43] gateway: tls handshake error: remote closed
```

Priya: @alex can you dump routes from one of the inference hosts? I suspect peering/route issue.

alex (oncall): running on host inf-01:
```
$ ip route show
10.0.0.0/16 via 10.1.0.1 dev eth0 proto static
10.200.0.0/16 via pcx-aaa (vpc-peering) dev eth1
10.200.0.0/16 via pcx-bbb (vpc-peering) dev eth2
default via 10.1.0.254 dev eth0
```

Priya: that's the smoking gun — two identical routes for 10.200.0.0/16 via different peering connections. Probable asymmetric routing. Running `aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections` now. snippet:
```
pcx-aaa State: active Tags: env=prod
pcx-bbb State: active Tags: automation_staging
```

Maria: ACME support note: customer reported 502s starting 09:12Z, spike to 4.6% at 09:18Z. We have support threads piling up. Need mitigation ASAP.

Jason: Are both peerings supposed to exist? If one is leftover from a terraform apply, it might not be accepted on the peer side or has route propagation differences.

alex (oncall): @Priya any quick mitigation that doesn't require full change? Maybe prefer pcx-aaa by adjusting route table priority or temporary blackhole the other peering.

Priya: I can remove the duplicate route from the route table for the affected subnet to force single path, but that requires a quick route change in prod. I'd rather add a more-specific route to prefer pcx-aaa for the CIDR used by inference: 10.200.123.0/24 -> pcx-aaa. Doing that now.

Priya: applying route change... 
```
$ aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0ab --destination-cidr-block 10.200.123.0/24 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-aaa
```

pagerduty-bot: Route change executed by Priya at 09:25:14Z

alex (oncall): running quick canary: curl -v https://private-gateway.prod/redwood/health
```
> GET /redwood/health
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

Maria: error rate dropping: 4.6% -> 0.4% after route change (09:27Z). Good.

Jason: I'll schedule removal of pcx-bbb; looks like automation mistakenly created peering from staging into prod VPC. Will coordinate rollback with infra.

ops-lead: Oncall handoff in 30m to Jason. Pager duty note: escalate to networking team for RCA. Paging SRE-ENG-NET.

Priya: Confirmed pcx-bbb is not part of intended topology. Creating ticket INFRA-3321 to remove peering and add guardrails in Terraform state.

alex (oncall): leaving thread, handing off to Jason (next oncall). Summary: duplicate vpc peering caused asymmetric routing and intermittent 502/504s; temp mitigation by adding specific route to prefer correct peering; customer impact - ACME saw ~4.6% failure briefly; no data loss. 

Jason: taking over. I'll monitor for an hour, then remove pcx-bbb and update routes. Will follow up with postmortem and Terraform fix.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged resolved (mitigated) at 09:40:02Z. Follow-up: postmortem due by EOD.

Maria: I'll update ACME support with summary and ETA for full fix.

Priya: RCA notes: race in infra automation created duplicate peering with tag automation_staging; route propagation resulted in two active paths. Action items: prevent duplicate peering creation, add route table validation, alert on multiple identical routes.

ops-lead: thx all. handing off fully to Jason. :thumbsup:
